mapper.insert: INSERT INTO std_account ( account_id, customer_id, account_type, balance, opened_at, active, source_system, event_type, extracted_at, consumed_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{customerId}, #{accountType}, #{balance}, #{openedAt}, #{active}, #{sourceSystem}, #{eventType}, #{extractedAt}, now() ) ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET customer_id = EXCLUDED.customer_id, account_type = EXCLUDED.account_type, balance = EXCLUDED.balance, opened_at = EXCLUDED.opened_at, active = EXCLUDED.active, source_system = EXCLUDED.source_system, event_type = EXCLUDED.event_type, extracted_at = EXCLUDED.extracted_at, consumed_at = now()
